description: When asked to push documents to the ReMarkable and then to spawn the agent using the remarkable skill, failed to check .claude/skills/ for a locally installed remarkable skill before concluding no capability existed and asking the user for their email address.
correction: Must check .claude/skills/ (and the IES skills directory) for locally installed skills before concluding a capability is unavailable. The Glob search ran against the plugin skills path only — not the user's local skill directory.
systemic_fix: When a user references a skill by name or capability, always search both the installed plugin skills path AND .claude/skills/ before declaring it unavailable.
